name: ACCE Optimizer
description: Governed adaptive model routing, cost optimization, quota preservation, and context-aware execution planning for OpenClaw.

mode.description: adaptive invokes the ACCE DecisionService graph; shadow observes without changing provider/model.

decisionServiceUrl.description: Private ACCE Python DecisionService bridge URL. Configure an address reachable from the Gateway container.

decisionServiceToken.description: Bearer token for the private ACCE DecisionService bridge. Keep secret.

allowExternalNetwork.description: Permit cloud routes only when fresh trusted quota/context state is configured on the ACCE bridge.

maxCloudCostUsd.description: Per-request cloud cost ceiling. Cloud routes remain disabled unless explicitly permitted and trusted state is available.

similarityHistoryPath.description: Private path for minimized task-category history. Raw prompts are never persisted.

similarityThreshold.description: Minimum matching-observation fraction required to reuse a task pattern as the default.

preferredRoutes.description: Explicit operator preferences by task class. These are soft ranking signals and never bypass route governance.

openclawCliPath.description: Path to the OpenClaw CLI used for documented, read-only runtime status polling.

runtimeStatusRefreshSeconds.description: Background refresh interval for models list and usage status. A stale/missing status snapshot cannot authorize a model override.

mode.label: Decision mode
mode.help: Adaptive uses the existing ACCE graph, hard constraints, cost/quota policy, and route ranking through the Python DecisionService. Shadow observes only.

autoDiscoverOnStartup.label: Discover models on first startup
autoDiscoverOnStartup.help: When enabled, an empty inventory triggers a background discovery. Existing inventories are not automatically recalibrated on every restart.

ollamaUrl.label: Ollama base URL
ollamaUrl.help: Explicit Ollama endpoint reachable from the OpenClaw Gateway process. In Docker deployments, this may be a host gateway URL such as http://host.docker.internal:11434.

inventoryPath.label: Private inventory path
inventoryPath.help: Absolute path or a path beginning with ~/. The inventory is stored with private file permissions.

decisionServiceUrl.label: ACCE DecisionService URL
decisionServiceUrl.help: HTTP bridge backed by the canonical Python DecisionService. The service must be reachable from the Gateway container.

decisionServiceToken.label: DecisionService bearer token
decisionServiceToken.help: Required when the bridge binds beyond loopback.

allowExternalNetwork.label: Allow external/cloud routes
allowExternalNetwork.help: Off by default. The bridge still fails closed to local routes unless fresh trusted quota/context telemetry and a usage ledger are configured.

maxCloudCostUsd.label: Maximum cloud cost per request
maxCloudCostUsd.help: USD ceiling for a single decision. This does not replace the monthly budget/usage ledger.

similarityHistoryPath.label: Task-pattern history path
similarityHistoryPath.help: Private JSON file storing only normalized task categories and timestamps, never prompt text.

similarityThreshold.label: Task-pattern consensus threshold
similarityThreshold.help: Default 80%. ACCE evaluates odd observation windows starting at 5 and expands until the threshold is met or available history is exhausted.

preferredRoutes.label: Explicit preferred routes
preferredRoutes.help: Optional soft preferences per task class, specified by exact providerId/modelId. The Python bridge resolves only routes already authorized in the registry and present in OpenClaw's runtime catalog.

openclawCliPath.label: OpenClaw CLI path
openclawCliPath.help: Executable path for the documented read-only models list/status usage commands.

runtimeStatusRefreshSeconds.label: Runtime status refresh interval (seconds)
runtimeStatusRefreshSeconds.help: Default 300 seconds. Fresh model availability and provider usage are required for ACCE overrides.
